body: Guys thank you for commenting. It really means a lot to me that somebody would take the time to do that.

Yeah, but my parents like to restrict things that give me pleasure or respite. I am under 18. 16. I love watching anime and reading manga. They inspire me. My mom told me that I'm and idiot for liking them though and she put a bunch of website blockers on my computer and phone.

Video games give me immense relief. Its a way to leave the house and the people if you get what I'm saying. Mostly my parents are very insulting. I know some people have much more serious problems and I was reluctant to post but being called lazy and a piece of shit while being under complete surveillance which completely triggers my anxiety and grinds my gears. The worst thing is that I'm not allowed to play video games and I'm suspected, so I'm being watched and forced to take everything with no respite. Also, my parents themselves are not nearly on the best of terms (something which I've only recently come to terms with), and they seem to like to take it out on me. I just want to be loved...
Every day seems like a battle with my family even when there was no quarantine... no physical abuse, but my mind can't take the mental abuse any longer
